text:
Alex: Heads-up: planning a gradual siphon to the green cluster for canary v2026-03-21 tonight during the 22:00-23:00 change window. Aim: reduce blast radius and observe token-cost and p95 changes.
Maya: Sounds good. Is this a full blue->green or cohorted by session? Need to know cookie behavior and whether router will respect existing sticky sessions.
Ravi: Router v4.3 will honor cookie if present but we have `sticky_session` set to soft. Expect some crossovers. We'll pin the service image: `service:inference:20260321-canary` and disable auto-roll for the window.
Alex: Canary cadence proposed: 0 -> 5 -> 15 -> 30 -> 60 -> 100. Hold durations: 3m, 4m, 8m, 8m, 5m. At any trigger we fast-abort to 0 in 90s.
Maya: Rollback triggers to wire into deploy job:
- error rate > 0.8% over 2 consecutive 1m windows
- p95 increase > 300ms vs baseline for 5m
- generation quality drop flagged by QA Bot
QA Bot: I'll run differential checks at 15% and 30% on the seeded prompts. Will post diffs.
Ravi: Adding watchers to deploy config:
```yaml
watchers:
  - metric: http_error_rate
    window: 1m
    threshold: 0.008
    consecutive: 2
    action: fast_abort
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    window: 5m
    threshold: 300
    action: shrink_then_abort
```
deploy-bot: Received plan. I will perform router operations and post step confirmations. Will create ephemeral channel #inc-179999-21 if any watcher fires.
Alex: Ops checklist: (1) pin tag, (2) disable autoscaler for canary pool, (3) pre-warm caches for green via smoke generator for 4m at 20rps, (4) set lb cookie ttl to 20m.
Maya: Pre-warm command: `./tools/prewarm --target green --rps 20 --time 240`
Ravi: Router commands for first steps:```bash
# set 5% in us-east-1 cohort
routerctl cohort set --to green --weight 5 --region us-east-1
routerctl cohort status --region us-east-1
```
Alex: We'll start at 22:00 UTC-7. deploy-bot, wait for my explicit `proceed` to begin. Manual holds at 15% and 30% only. Others auto-advance if healthy.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Will not start until `proceed`. I will timestamp each step and attach perf deltas.
Maya: One more: DB migrations are non-blocking, but feature-flag kill-switch is ready on `feat.inference.v2.3` if QA finds generation regressions.
QA Bot: First diff run scheduled at 15% will compare 200 seeded prompts and report avg BLEU-like metric and any hallucination spikes.
Alex: OK final: safety gate behavior on region failure -> shrink to 25% then 0% over 90s. If global issues, full abort immediate and pager via Oncall Bot.
Oncall Bot: I will page if any watcher executes `fast_abort` or `shrink_then_abort`. Creating incident #inc-179999-21 now.
Ravi: All set from infra. Leave me the manual advance rights to push beyond the 30% hold.
Maya: I'll be on traces and cache-hit. Alex you run the router steps.
Alex: I'll post a start notice 5m prior. If no objections, I'll `proceed` at 21:55 local for a 22:00 start.
Maya: No objections.
Ravi: Good to go.
Alex: proceed
deploy-bot: STEP: cohort set 5% -> green (us-east-1) running. Posting back when status OK.```
